process.description: The process used for generating samples.

initial.description:
Value for the first sample, used for stochastic processes. If not specified, a value will be generated near
the midpoint of #origin and #bound (in the middle third of the range).

positiveFraction.description:
The probability of an upward change instead of downward on each successive point when using stochastic processes.
A value of 0.6 would mean a 60% chance of positive deltas and a 40% chance of negative.

deltaMax.description:
The maximum change for each successive point, when using the random walk process. If null, 1% of the range is used.
If specified, this must be >= #deltaMin. This value is inclusive.

deltaMin.description: The minimum change for each successive point, when using the random walk process.

source.description:
The source of the timeseries data series, if not specified by the caller.

@see TimeseriesSourceInfo#source

expr.description:
The expression for the timeseries data points, if not specified by the caller.

@see TimeseriesSourceInfo#expr

unit.description: The unit to use for the timeseries.

title:
Options for generating random timeseries data.

@see Timeseries#randomTimeseries
